title: Baked Sweet Potato Wedges
description: Simple oven-roasted sweet potato wedges seasoned with cooking spray and salt or a spice mix of choice.
ingredients: salt or spice mix of your choice (see pp.212–213)
steps: Cover a baking tray with parchment; add sweet potato cubes; spray with cooking spray.
Roast 30 minutes until golden brown and starting to crisp on the edges.
notes: Season with any of the spice mixes on pp.212–213 for variety. Garlic Aïoli (p.140) makes a delicious dip.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
